AuthorityRef.description: A decision right attached to an execution.
AuthorityRef.title: AuthorityRef

CapabilityBinding.description: A resource executing the process. Resources (people, teams, tools) appear only here.

evidence_ref.description: Where the capability is evidenced; None means asserted, not evidenced.
evidence_ref.title: Evidence Ref

resource_id.description: Resource id; never an object id.
resource_id.title: Resource Id

resource_role.description: Role, not a person's name, in shared artifacts.
resource_role.title: Resource Role

CapabilityBinding.title: CapabilityBinding

ObjectIncidence.description: What one execution does to one object. Objects are things, never people.

destination_buffer.description: transfers only: buffer (place) the object arrives at. Set with origin_buffer or not at all.
destination_buffer.title: Destination Buffer

effect.description: produces=birth, consumes=death, revises/transfers/holds=state change, checks=gate, reads=no change.
effect.title: Effect

object_id.description: Persistent object id (one per asset; references to it are not new objects).
object_id.title: Object Id

object_kind.description: Caller vocabulary, e.g. drawing, purchase_order, device.
object_kind.title: Object Kind

origin_buffer.description: transfers only: buffer (place) the object leaves. Optional; HFGT reports a gap when missing.
origin_buffer.title: Origin Buffer

state_after.description: State after the execution, where the effect changes state.
state_after.title: State After

state_before.description: Expected state before the execution, if asserted.
state_before.title: State Before

ObjectIncidence.title: ObjectIncidence

ProcessType.description: A kind of process: what it does to objects, independent of any project instance.

approved.description: True only after a process SME signs off the classification; inferred classes stay False.
approved.title: Approved

code.description: Caller vocabulary process code, e.g. 'design' or a catalogue number.
code.title: Code

function_classes.description: What the process does: transform, transport, hold, exchange, control.
function_classes.title: Function Classes

ProcessType.title: ProcessType

description: The root record: one execution of a process type. Everything else is derived from executions.

at_buffer.description: Buffer (place) where a transform, control or hold happens. Optional; HFGT reports a gap when missing.
at_buffer.title: At Buffer

epistemic_status.description: computed = from records; simulated work can never release.
epistemic_status.title: Epistemic Status

executed_by.description: Who executed it. Empty means the executor is unknown.
executed_by.title: Executed By

incidence.description: Objects the execution acts on, one entry per object.
incidence.title: Incidence

occurred_at.description: Real timestamp, if recorded. Required before process claims.
occurred_at.title: Occurred At

sequence.description: Caller ordering within ties; None means unordered.
sequence.title: Sequence

stage.description: Caller stage code; the participation null never crosses stages.
stage.title: Stage

subsystem_id.description: Subsystem the execution belongs to, if known.
subsystem_id.title: Subsystem Id

verification_evidence.description: Object ids the decision relied on; each must be read or checked here.
verification_evidence.title: Verification Evidence

title: ProcessExecution
